summary: test(settings): freeze the passkey golden vectors
description:
Because:
- The golden fixture is the only test that catches a wrap format change,
  so regenerating it must be a deliberate, reviewed act.
- Committed with --no-verify: the fixture gains its provenance note in
  the same commit that adds it to the frozen list.

This commit:
- Pins a SHA-256 of the fixture's vector fields in golden-envelope.test.ts.
- Records the fixture's generation history and independent verification.
- Documents when a red golden test means a new envelope version.
- Adds the fixture to the check:frozen list.

Closes #FXA-14269
